business.description: Phil & Sons on Main Italian restaurant and pizzeria is a pizza restaurant in Flushing, NY.

reviews.author: Fulton Hou
reviews.text: Great people working here, suppose Sal is a good guy too. Got the drunken grandma pie, but somehow favorite part of it was the crust

reviews.author: Kevin Megnauth
reviews.text: Classic NYC slice on main street. A nice quick meal if you are visiting NYP Hospital.

reviews.author: Guap Sef
reviews.text: Food was fantastic! The barbecue chicken slice is a must try. Dragon slayer burger came with a kick give it a try

reviews.author: Michelle Ongkingco
reviews.text: This old school pizza place is where it's at. I've been coming here since I was a little kid and their pizza is like home to me. Comforting. Love their specialty pizzettas (lasagna pie is amaaazing- as well as the Phil's special). So happy they've endured here on Main Street since so many places in the area have turned into Chinese food spots. If you want a slice of OG New York pizza this is where to go.

faq.q: Where is Phil & Sons on Main Italian restaurant and pizzeria?
faq.a: Phil & Sons on Main Italian restaurant and pizzeria is at 57-29 Main St, Queens, NY 11355, in Flushing. It's in Queensboro Hill, beside Chase Bank and Yeh's Bakery, near NewYork-Presbyterian Queens Hospital.
We're open Mon–Sun 11 AM to 9 PM.
There's a free parking lot. The nearest bus stop is Main St/Booth Memorial Av, just steps away.

faq.q: Can I order ahead for pickup?
faq.a: Yes. Order online at philandsonsonmain.com/order-now and pick it up at the counter.

Phil & Sons on Main Italian restaurant and pizzeria delivers the full menu from 57-29 Main St to homes and offices in Queens and nearby Flushing Chinatown, Murray Hill and Pomonok, within about 2 miles of the restaurant. There's a $15 minimum order. Order online at philandsonsonmain.com/order-now or call (718) 961-0263 during our hours (Mon–Sun 11 AM to 9 PM).

faq.q: What should I order the first time?
faq.a: Start with our signature dishes: the Meat Lovers Pizza (Large) ($31.50), the Fried Calamari ($14.20), the Mozzarella Sticks ($8.20) and the Baked Ziti ($9.95).

faq.q: How much does a meal cost?
faq.a: Most dishes on the Phil & Sons on Main Italian restaurant and pizzeria menu cost $8.25 to $31. The menu has 21 sections: Lunch Specials, Weekend Pasta Special, Salads, Soups, Appetizers, Burgers, Hot Heroes, Cold Heroes, Fresh Homemade Panini & Wraps, From the Grill, Pasta, Entrees, Calzone & Rolls, Lunch Time Menu, Pizza Night Special, Pizza, Family Time Specials, Desserts, Side Orders & Vegetables, Drinks & Coffee and Seafood Entree, with every price listed on the menu page.

business.ownerWords:
Phil & Sons on Main Italian restaurant and pizzeria is a pizza restaurant at 57-29 Main St in Queens, in Flushing, NY. Look for us in Queensboro Hill, beside Chase Bank and Yeh's Bakery, near NewYork-Presbyterian Queens Hospital. We're open for lunch and dinner, seven days a week.

The pizza list runs 58 choices long, from the Cheese Neapolitan Pizza to the Pizzeta Personal Pizza. There's also a pizza night special list with one choices. The Meat Lovers Pizza (Large) ($31.50) is made with pepperoni, sausage, meatball & mozzarella. The Fried Calamari ($14.20) is made with lightly breaded; fried to golden perfection. For guests who avoid gluten or skip meat, the menu has the Eggplant Lasagna ( Vegetarian ), the Cauliflower Gluten Free Pizza and the Vegan Sicilian Pie (Large).

Guests rate Phil & Sons on Main Italian restaurant and pizzeria 4.3 stars across 602+ Google reviews. “Great people working here, suppose Sal is a good guy too.” (Fulton Hou, Google review) “A nice quick meal if you are visiting NYP Hospital.” (Kevin Megnauth, Google review)

You can eat in, take out or order delivery. You can order ahead online and pick it up at the restaurant. We deliver within about 2 miles with a $15 minimum. There's a free parking lot. Come see us at 57-29 Main St in Queens, or call (718) 961-0263 to order.
